## Iconic Scents to Add to Your Queue


One of the best things about Etat Libre d’Orange is its incredible range. While the brand is famous for its unusual perfumes, it also masters the art of simplicity. ### Must-Try: I Am Trash


Don’t let the name fool you—I Am Trash (Les Fleurs du Déchet) is a stunningly beautiful fragrance and one of ELDO’s most popular creations. Built on the concept of upcycling, it uses exhausted raw materials and spent ingredients to create something entirely new and wonderful. The result is a bright, fruity-floral scent with notes of apple, strawberry, and rose that feels both modern and timeless. With over 167 reviews on the[brand’s official site](https://etatlibredorange.us/?srsltid=AfmBOopQIi9pppf8oCsRC-689AFFP69Fs50t1GaKAyc7Y6HxTmx1ZL3r) , it’s clear this fragrance has captured the hearts of many. It’s a must-try for anyone who loves a scent with a great story.


### Must-Try: Fat Electrician


Another fan favorite with a quirky name, Fat Electrician is a warm, woody, and surprisingly sophisticated scent. It’s a semi-gourmand fragrance that blends vetiver with notes of olive leaf, vanilla, and myrrh, creating a smooth, creamy, and utterly addictive aroma. It’s the kind of scent that feels comforting yet intriguing, making it perfect for cooler weather or cozy nights in. It has earned over 100 reviews from fans who have fallen for its unique charm. If you’re looking for a fragrance that’s distinctive and memorable, Fat Electrician is definitely one to add to your Scentbird queue.
